name: prd-pr-copilot
description: Copilot CLI variant of the workshop dev workflow — orchestrator skill plus helper subagents (code-explorer, code-architect, plan-reviewer, impl-backend, impl-frontend, impl-simplify, test-plan-walker) and the supporting skill suite, including a consolidated post-implementation quality round (refactor and full test-suite regression over the whole story) and an end-to-end test-plan walkthrough that runs in a clean subagent context, embeds agent-browser screenshots into the PR description, and persists a Playwright e2e spec per slice into the project's existing e2e suite. Agents use Copilot's .agent.md format.
